model: Shettle & Fenn (1979) rural aerosol, RH 70 %, bimodal number-lognormal; Bohren-Huffman spheres (mie.py)
phase_convention: phase = mean-one phase function (integral over the sphere / 4 pi = 1) on theta_deg; chi_l coefficients of P_l (chi_0=1); SH eigenvalue chi_l/(2l+1)

quadrature.theta: Gauss-Legendre panels 0-0.5-2-5-10-20-40-90-180 deg (528 nodes) for chi_l

phase_550_per_sr.note: LOWTRAN PHSFNC 4 (rural 0/70 % at 0.55/0.69 um) is a binned average; compare shape only
